name: bank-byte-access
source:
Reserve As Work 4,4
Poke Start(4),511
Print Peek(Start(4))
Key Speed 10,2

encoding.notes: Explicit original offsets Reserve As Work=20f2, Start=0140, Poke=21ca, Peek=21e6 and Key Speed=11c6, with independent decimal payloads and physical line lengths. No production encoder or name table.

evidence.notes: Source-derived expectations: Peek zero-extends a byte, Poke stores the low byte, Key Speed converts 50ths to input-device time. AMOScript uses bounded virtual bank addresses rather than original machine addresses. No captured AMOS execution.
